content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily. Research shows you can build similar muscle with lighter loads (roughly 30-85% of your 1RM) as long as your sets are taken close to failure, about 0-3 reps in reserve. Heavier work in the 5-10 rep range is more time-efficient and builds strength faster, and that matters for your 100 kg bench goal. 💪

The best approach for you is mostly moderate reps (6-12) with some heavy sets of 3-6 on the bench, plus enough weekly volume and progressive overload. Want me to check how your bench is progressing?
